name: RP36 reliever shadow addendum
summary: Initial shell for the current E36 reliever shadow layer. RP36 is an addendum consumed by M0, focused on first-up reliever clusters, bullpen path, availability, and bridge risk.
keyImprovements: Separates the relief stack from the parent MLB model without promoting it to a competing model.
Preserves the E36 shadow label as a legacy alias while giving the component a stable cartridge name.
Documents the current source chain before moving any relief code.

keyMetrics.label: Latest audited exact first-up
keyMetrics.details: May 30 target-date shadow check, 20 team-side games graded.

notes: RP36 should inform sides, totals, props, and late-game risk; it should not produce final board picks alone.
The first behavior-preserving migration test should compare against the 2026-05-30 reliever-shadow artifact.
The current exporter still emits E36 shadow in payload metadata.
knownLimitations: No formal RP36 model-run manifest exists yet.
No settlement table exists for first-up reliever predictions yet.
Current artifacts are useful but not standalone betting signals.
